scope: Proposition 6.7 (Pure signs in full isotypic components) of the manuscript “Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature” (preprints/Entropy-equality-and-local-symmetry-in-negative-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 339 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8658ab8209a8aa0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If B ̸= 0, let P′ = socl(B∗ ) ⊂ P (6.7) under the transferred representation of Lemma 6.6; the socle is the sum of all irreducible submodules. It is nonzero. Its two H-sign parts are sums of full u-isotypic components, and in particular are invariant under the full transferred u action. If h is finite dimensional and l = h, then E is a semisimple k-module whose H-sign parts are sums of full isotypic components. In either case there are only finitely many possible sums of isotypic components in the module under consideration.
